plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Biology: Pre-Nursing Option A.S. Degree - Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 25, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7869/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local. Map states Total Units 62; verified = 14+14+18+16 = 62 (all semester headers match their rows). Designed for students intending to apply to ADN programs or transfer to a 4-year nursing program; does not prepare for immediate employment as a nurse. BIOL 430 pre-req per map: CHEM 305, 309, or 400 — encoded as CHEM 305 (the in-plan option); alternatives CHEM 309/400 documented here. BIOL 440 pre-req per map: CHEM 305, 309, or 400 — encoded as CHEM 305; alternatives documented here. Map footnote recommends not taking BIOL 430 and BIOL 440 in the same semester (sequenced in Semesters 2 and 4 here). PSYC C1000 advisories (recommended, not required): ENGL C1000, ENGL C1000H, or ESLW 340; and LIBR 318. Local Area 2 suggestion: STAT C1000E Introduction to Statistics. Elective slots: open electives whose units are determined by the number needed to total 60 units for graduation, per map footnote; refer to Course Number for the appropriate course level. Local Areas 1A and 2: map recommends meeting with a counselor. Individual nursing programs may have specific prerequisite requirements; meet with a counselor for transfer course evaluation.
